english.title: Occupier make a false statement to local housing authority relating to the number of persons sleeping in a dwelling
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), in purported compliance with a notice from the local housing authority requiring a written statement of the number, age and sex of persons sleeping in that dwelling, gave a statement that was false in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 335(2)(b) of the Housing Act 1985.
